NewsArticle.Title: Maintenance
NewsArticle.Content: 00.05.24 at 11 p.m., Dark Ages may be offline for up to 30 minutes for scheduled maintenance and internal structure upgrades. Afterwards, service may be unstable through 2 a.m. 05/25. Please report abnormal software behavior: [www.darkages.com/contact](http://www.darkages.com/contact) Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
